registeredRoots: POST /auth/login -> loginWithPassword -> password verification -> manufacturer bootstrap
POST /auth/refresh -> verified non-revoked refresh session -> manufacturer bootstrap
signed access or MFA-bootstrap token -> authenticate/authenticateAnySession -> manufacturer bootstrap
GET /auth/me -> verified session claims -> manufacturer bootstrap

authoritativeTables.purpose: Prove the password-authenticated manufacturer actor, activation state and manufacturer-role ceiling.
Prove the exact manufacturer-to-licensee membership set and deterministic primary ordering.
Prove the selected licensee and its organization, active state and approved display label.
Prove that the selected licensee organization remains active.
For refresh/session roots only, prove the actor session is current and not revoked.

identityProofChain.verificationPoint: After lookup_password_user returns exactly one active account and the supplied password verifies; session roots instead require a valid signed token whose userId is revalidated against the User row and, for refresh, a non-expired non-revoked RefreshToken.
identityProofChain.authoritativeManufacturerUserId: User.id from the verified account row; email, request fields and token role or tenant claims are never manufacturer identity authority.
identityProofChain.authoritativeRelationship: ManufacturerLicenseeLink where manufacturerId equals the verified User.id and licenseeId joins one active Licensee whose Organization is active.
identityProofChain.activeRelationshipRule: The link row must exist; User must be ACTIVE/isActive with no disabledAt/deletedAt; Licensee must be active with no suspendedAt; Organization must be active. ManufacturerLicenseeLink has no expiry or revocation fields, so link deletion is the current revocation operation and temporal membership is not implied.
identityProofChain.organizationLicenseeScope: licenseeId and organizationId come only from the verified link -> Licensee.orgId relationship. User.licenseeId and User.orgId are legacy consistency hints, never scope authority.
uniquenessExpectations: Password lookup fails closed unless normalized email identifies exactly one User.
ManufacturerLicenseeLink composite primary key prevents duplicate manufacturerId/licenseeId pairs.
At most one eligible link may have isPrimary=true; multiple primaries are an ambiguity failure.
Licensee.orgId is unique, so one organization cannot resolve to multiple Licensee rows.

inputFields.name: verifiedUserId
inputFields.trustedSource: password-verification result or revalidated signed session

trustedInputSources.userId: verified password result or revalidated signed session plus User.id
trustedInputSources.licenseeId: ManufacturerLicenseeLink.licenseeId selected only from the verified membership set
trustedInputSources.organizationId: Licensee.orgId joined from the selected verified membership

exactReturnedColumns.name: manufacturerUserId
exactReturnedColumns.reason: Bind the projection to the verified actor.

exactReturnedColumns.name: accountRole

exactReturnedColumns.reason: Identify an eligible membership and allow server-verified narrowing.

exactReturnedColumns.name: organizationId

exactReturnedColumns.name: relationshipStatus

exactReturnedColumns.name: displayName

exactReturnedColumns.name: scopeVersion

membershipSelectionRules.overflowBehavior: Fetch at most 101; if more than 100 eligible links exist, fail closed with MEMBERSHIP_SET_TOO_LARGE and require administrative correction.
membershipSelectionRules.initialSelection: One eligible link is selected automatically. With several links, exactly one primary is selected; with no primary, no active scope is installed and the verified actor must select from the returned bounded set; multiple primaries fail closed.

multiLicenseeBehavior.returns: All eligible links up to maximumEligibleLinks using exactReturnedColumns.
multiLicenseeBehavior.selectionProof: The request carries a password-verified MFA-bootstrap token or active mfa-verified session, and requestedLicenseeId must exactly match the freshly re-read verified membership set and scopeVersion.

duplicateHandling.normalizedUserDuplicates: Deny with the same external response as no user match.
duplicateHandling.duplicateMembershipPair: Prevented by the composite primary key; any database inconsistency fails closed.
duplicateHandling.multiplePrimaryMemberships: Deny bootstrap and active-scope installation; do not choose by row order.

disabledRevokedBehavior.expiryModel: ManufacturerLicenseeLink has no expiry field; no temporal membership is inferred. If expiry is added later, expired rows must be excluded before this contract can be certified.
disabledRevokedBehavior.revocationModel: Absence of the link row is the current revocation state.
disabledRevokedBehavior.inconsistentLegacyTenantFields: If non-null User.licenseeId is not eligible, or non-null User.orgId matches no eligible linked licensee, deny and require repair. Never use either field as fallback authority.

contextKeysInstalled.tenantKeysBeforeSelection: app.licensee_id and app.organization_id are not authority and may not authorize any tenant read before an eligible membership is selected.

failureSemantics.noUserMatch: AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; identical external response to duplicate normalized user and invalid password.
failureSemantics.duplicateNormalizedUsers: AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; no actor context or membership read.
failureSemantics.disabledUser: AUTHENTICATION_FAILED before actor bootstrap; do not expose membership state.
failureSemantics.wrongRole: AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; only the three manufacturer roles are accepted.
failureSemantics.noActiveRelationship: MANUFACTURER_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED after password verification; issue no active session or tenant context and return no membership identifiers.
failureSemantics.requestedForeignLicensee: MANUFACTURER_SCOPE_DENIED with no foreign membership detail.
failureSemantics.revokedRelationship: MANUFACTURER_SCOPE_DENIED after the fresh membership read.
failureSemantics.disabledTenant: MANUFACTURER_SCOPE_DENIED; active Licensee and Organization are mandatory.
failureSemantics.unsupportedAssurance: AUTH_ASSURANCE_REQUIRED; password-verified for bootstrap and mfa-verified for active/switch operations.
failureSemantics.staleSession: INVALID_OR_EXPIRED_SESSION; perform no membership read after session validation fails.
failureSemantics.missingRequestId: REQUEST_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRED; perform no protected membership read.
failureSemantics.blankScope: Never means all. Auto-select only the sole eligible link or sole primary; otherwise SCOPE_SELECTION_REQUIRED.
failureSemantics.invitationNotFullyConsumed: AUTHENTICATION_FAILED while User is INVITED, lacks passwordHash/emailVerifiedAt, or is inactive. Invite fields are not read by bootstrap and are not post-activation authority.

allowScenarios: One password-verified active manufacturer reads only its own eligible memberships with actor-only transaction context and server request attribution.
A requested licensee narrows scope only after exact membership and scopeVersion verification.
One eligible membership or exactly one primary membership becomes the initial scope in a fresh transaction.
An mfa-verified active manufacturer switches to another freshly verified eligible membership with audit attribution.
denyScenarios: Email, JWT tenant claims, query/body role or licensee fields, blank scope, platform role strings or legacy User tenant fields establish authority.
Foreign, missing, revoked, disabled, suspended, expired, excessive, duplicate-primary or inconsistent membership sets produce context.
Secret-bearing, platform-admin, unrelated-user, full-tenant or broad-audit fields enter the projection.
Bootstrap executes before actor verification or scope switching occurs without mfa-verified assurance, request attribution, a fresh transaction and audit.
postgresqlCertificationRequirements: Actor-only context can select ManufacturerLicenseeLink rows only where manufacturerId equals verified app.manufacturer_id.
Empty, forged, foreign and caller-selected tenant context is denied and never becomes a wildcard.
Disabled User, Licensee or Organization and missing/revoked link rows are denied.
Exact projection excludes every prohibited column and uses the same transaction client after context installation.
Scope selection and switching re-read membership, install exact tenant keys in a fresh transaction and append required audit attribution.
Multiple-primary, overflow, stale scopeVersion, missing requestId and insufficient assurance cases fail closed.

unlockAnalysis.effect: Semantic decision resolved; eligible for a later focused runtime implementation after the actor-context repository and deterministic tests exist.
Only the authentication/bootstrap slice is approved.
remainingBlockers: invitation mutation must be separated from actor bootstrap
